_comment: Machine-checkable pin for the vendored cardano-foundation/cpt-rwa-ch-de-cmta-reference tree.
Do not hand-edit any file in this directory: run ./verify-upstream-pin.sh --regenerate instead.
Upstream MOVED here from easy1staking-com/fn-bafin-cardano-sc, which is where every pin before
2026-08-21 pointed. The lineage is continuous -- the old pin's base commit 8e174601 is an
ancestor of this one -- so this is a relocation plus new work, not a different codebase.
The pin is back in 'commit' mode: the previous entry recorded a local dirty working tree
because there was no published revision matching the vendored bytes. There is one now.
blueprint_reproduced_note: UPSTREAM'S COMMITTED plutus.json IS STALE and is deliberately NOT vendored verbatim. At e196783, rebuilding the vendored source with the very compiler the pin records (aiken v1.1.23+8949565) reproduces every validator EXCEPT global_state.global_state_spend_validator: committed 57e2c6d5ca432b24871d113a1f0f4664ca4ea574d8ce892537356f49 (4901 bytes) vs rebuilt e720eb536b26eb8c639e96a17de4404ab4dbf18224ae9cc2242e13a9 (4698 bytes). The build is deterministic (verified by two clean builds) and plutus.json and validators/global_state.ak were last touched by the SAME commit (30ea3ac), so the blueprint was committed without being regenerated after a final source edit. We vendor the REBUILT blueprint, because the deployed script must be the source that gets audited -- shipping the committed bytes would put a global_state spend validator on chain that does not correspond to validators/global_state.ak. This is an upstream defect worth fixing there; once it is, drop blueprint_source and re-run --regenerate. verify-upstream-pin.sh asserts BOTH hashes above, so the day upstream regenerates its blueprint the check fails loudly instead of silently keeping this exception.

excluded_from_vendoring.README.md: Upstream's README is documentation only and affects no compiled artifact. Excluded from the diff in verify-upstream-pin.sh and absent from `files` below, so re-adding it makes SecurityTokenUpstreamPinTest fail with UNEXPECTED README.md.
excluded_from_vendoring..claude/: Local editor state in the maintainer's checkout, not part of the contract. Excluded so a machine-specific settings file never becomes a pinned input.
